👋 I'm Vincent. In 2017, I received my Bachelor of Science in mathematics & a minor in statistics from <a href="https://www.psu.edu" style="color: #1e407c">Penn State</a>. Afterward, I spent 5+ years at what is now [Peraton](https://www.peraton.com) working a few Geospatial Intelligence data science missions on the [NGA's](https://www.nga.mil) enterprise systems engineering contract. Recently, I was an AI Engineer at Booz Allen where I conducted statistical performance analyses against Earth observing satellite imagery object detection algorithms. 

I've been traveling a lot lately.

Over the past year and a half I've added 23 new countries to my personal list.

Before this, I traveled ~13,000 miles by car across the United States <a class="usa" href="usapop.html" target="_blank"></a> from the East to the West coast. I'm always searching for my next [big]{style='font-size:1.1em'} (or [tiny]{style='font-size:0.75em'}) adventure.

I enjoy spatial analytics. I hope to shed some light on spatial topics through effectively communicating technical concepts in [my blog](/posts/). It's built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org).

As I've been traveling, I've created content through cinematic story telling, photography, & drone piloting. I've logged 220 drone missions spanning 500km & 60 hours of flight time.

A section of this site is dedicated to combining travel with math & code — where I share my travel photography along with each of my computational answers & bite sized explanations to the [Project Euler](/euler/) problems.

When I'm not head down in geeky stuff, I also enjoy salsa dancing, sports (go birds 🦅), and jumping out of aircraft (did it once - was fun & a bit terrifying).

If you're interested in learning more about my career, here's a web version of my [résumé](/resume){.external target='_blank'}.

You can reach me by email at: vincent.clemson{@}gmail.com

Also, feel free to connect with me on [LinkedIn {{< fa brands linkedin >}}](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vincentclemson/).

Thanks for stopping by. ✌️
